mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have 70 degree temperatures with overcast skies near the Military Ridge State Trail. The moon is currently in its First Quarter phase. Tonight, there will be a visible pass of the ISS starting at 8:27 PM for 4 minutes, rising in the northwest over Verona High School and heading toward the northeast near Home Depot.

City officials have announced that road maintenance featuring chip seal treatments begins on Wednesday, September 23. While roads will remain open, drivers should prepare for lane closures and traffic control. Also, a reminder that the Plan Commission is meeting on October 5 to discuss various development projects.

There is plenty to do around town starting today with live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard. Tomorrow, you can head to Paoli for the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival or visit the Dane County Farmers Market at the Capitol Square. Additionally, Bike the Barns takes place this Saturday at Badger Prairie County Park.
In our latest review of calls, the department noted that they are actively seeking new patrol officers and encouraged service-minded individuals to apply through the city website.
Culver's is currently open until 10:30 PM this evening; however, please be aware that the restaurant is currently closed for a remodel, so the flavor of the day is not available.
